label: The actual contingents' joint absence is realized by a holder's withholding being from each
paraphrase: Some being exists at w, has at w a power for the joint absence of the concrete beings contingent at w, and exists at an accessible world where they are all absent, while it gives being (GivesTo) at w to every concrete being contingent at w and gives none of them being at that world. With some such being, the holder is a two-way giver in the withholding form (TwoWayGiverAt; controls, law 6). Nothing is said about what decides the withholding.
